scope: Individually inspected 36 ordered sample frames across fleet and coast in phone and fallback profiles. This is a sampled sequence, not continuous playback.
verdict: Positive for finding the aircraft and reading the next action at a glance. Contextual return state is visible. Overlapping carrier geometry and hit feedback still obscure the aircraft itself, and status information on the brackets is too small to decode in a busy scene.
remaining: Critical hull percentage is legible off-airframe. During a hit the airframe flashes solid white in sampled frames 006 and 012; this does not establish the flash duration.
An offset blue-gray shape near the fleet and steep bank remains ambiguous.
Coast shows the recovery marker at the runway. Arrival at an outpost, active capture, overheated feedback, touch targets, safe areas, and continuous motion remain unverified.

coast-fallback-000.png.evidence: The active-course header and nearest-base line separate the two instructions. Brackets identify the plane on runway. The hull readout already shows 35%.

coast-fallback-006.png.evidence: The damage flash masks the aircraft texture. Brackets retain ownership. The header switches to IN STATION and RETURN TO BASE, removing the old secondary line.

coast-fallback-012.png.evidence: The plane remains a solid pale shape with dark brackets. The yellow recovery mark near the runway and cyan Hawk cue compete mildly.

coast-fallback-024.png.evidence: Camouflage returns as the aircraft heads off runway. The fixed bracket orientation is useful for tracking despite bank.

coast-fallback-036.png.evidence: The bracketed profile narrows near a tree and threshold. Recovery marker is still visible behind the aircraft.

coast-fallback-060.png.evidence: Orange blast brightens the right bracket momentarily. Player remains at the midpoint of the two brackets while the base instruction persists.

coast-fallback-090.png.evidence: Bank over dark water reduces plane contrast. Nearby bright paired tracers look more prominent than the local status markings.

coast-fallback-120.png.evidence: Runway is clearly behind the bank. Recovery label appears near the runway, and the top course arrow and map player move relative to it.

coast-fallback-180.png.evidence: Aircraft still framed near water edge, with the left bracket dark against grass. IN STATION remains while the player is visually offshore, so the exact station bounds are unclear.
